import json
r = json.load(open('runs.json'))
bnb5m = next((x for x in r if x['id']==21), None)
if bnb5m:
    print(f'Прогон id 21: {bnb5m["name"]}')
    print(f'  Пара: {bnb5m["sym"]}')
    print(f'  ТФ: {bnb5m["cfg"].get("tf")}')
    print(f'  Сделок: {len(bnb5m.get("trades",[]))}')
    print(f'  hand_forward: {bnb5m["cfg"].get("hand_forward")}')
    trades = bnb5m.get('trades',[])
    if trades:
        for t in trades[:3]:
            print(f'    {t}')
else:
    print('Прогон id 21 не найден!')
    print('\nВсе BNBUSDT прогоны:')
    for x in r:
        if x['sym']=='BNBUSDT':
            print(f'  id {x["id"]}: {x["name"]} tf={x["cfg"].get("tf")}')
EOF
